name: World Gear
lines: The Smithy's front counter
Edda Gable, the outfitter
The sabre of the city's night watch: light, quick, and balanced for a long shift.
A short crossbow from the Tower armoury; its heavy bolts knock a foe back.
Long, warm and lined with leather plates where a blow would land.
A polished helm with the Tower's crest.
A tall elk from the woods beyond the Ring, broken to the saddle by the city's grooms.
Commuter's lucky coin
Rubbed smooth by a thousand thumbs.
The Tranquillity Outfitters
Juno Albedo, outfitter
A miner's pick made heavy for fighting; every blow sends a foe reeling, as if gravity let go.
Tranquillity pulse pistol
A compact pulse pistol made for the low pull of the Moon; it fires fast.
Mare Haven surface suit
A white suit with stiffened panels, made for the grey plains.
A rounded helm with a gold-tinted visor against the hard sunlight.
A great white hare bred in the domes; it bounds in long, light leaps.
A pendant of Moon basalt.
A tiny picture of the Earth rising.
The Red Bazaar outfitters
Hollis Dray, outfitter
The Basalt Mine forge
A curved blade with a heated edge, once a tool for cutting basalt blocks; it leaves foes burning.
A long rifle made for the thin air and long sight-lines of the red plains.
A long rust-red coat with sealed seams, made for the great dust storms.
Heavy gloves armoured at the knuckles, for climbing and for fighting.
A great rust-red scorpion, tame and steady; its saddle sits behind the claws.
A disc of red iron.
A runner's wristband from the Jezero track.
The Graphite Exchange outfitters
Sabine Kettle, outfitter
The Caloris Smelter
the smelter master
A maul with a head still warm from the smelter; foes struck by it burn.
A heavy flare pistol for signalling across the sunside; its shells burn.
Layered silver plates that throw back the sun, and blows besides.
Thick-soled boots for the hot ground of the crater floor.
A slow, broad tortoise with a dark shell; nothing frightens it, and it carries you safely.
A sealed vial of silver coolant.
Mercury runs round the Sun fastest of all.
The Cloud Exchange outfitters
Lisette Mardoux, outfitter
A slender rapier made for duelling on the cloud-city's high walks; it strikes fast.
A fighting fan whose gust is cold and choking; foes caught in it slow down.
Aphelia duelling coat
A fitted rose-gold coat with hidden mail.
A light cape of yellow-gold silk that catches a glancing blow.
A winged horse with a pearl-pink coat, bred above the clouds. It flies.
Venus is the brightest star of morning.
A ribbon that floats as you fall.
The Ice Exchange outfitters
Ansel Quarrie, outfitter
The Ice Quarry forge
An axe chilled in the nitrogen works; foes it strikes slow and stiffen.
Tombaugh freeze lance
A beam of cold from the ice quarries; it slows whatever it touches.
The warmest coat in the system, quilted and armoured.
Heart-plain fur cap
A fur-lined cap named for the pale heart on Pluto's face.
Tombaugh frost bear
A pale blue-white bear that loves the cold; slow to anger, impossible to stop.
A heart of clear ice that never melts.
At Pluto the Sun is only a bright star.
The Banded Exchange outfitters
Corvin Halley, outfitter
A rod that hums like the Great Red Spot; its bolts throw foes back.
A gas-skimmer's harpoon made a weapon; each strike draws back a little vigour.
Banded pressure suit
A suit striped in Jupiter's bands, made for the crushing deep air.
A round helm with a wide window for watching the storms.
A young sky-whale from the deep bands, gentle and vast. It swims through the air.
Four small beads for the four great moons.
A ring with a swirling red stone.
The Ringside Exchange outfitters
Delphine Arcos, outfitter
A glaive with a blade curved like the rings; it sweeps quick and wide.
A thrown disc of ice-hardened steel that comes back to the hand.
Pale-gold plate ringed with bands, worn by the Ringside Guard.
An orange-brown mantle the colour of Titan's sky.
A golden griffin bred on the ring-viewing terraces. It flies.
Enceladus spray charm
A bead of the icy moon's spray.
Saturn would float on a great enough sea.
The Haze Exchange outfitters
Petra Linden, outfitter
The Skimmer Works of Celadine
A spear that seems to come at you from the side, as the planet's winds do.
Celadine ice rifle
A pulse rifle firing shards of blue ice; foes it hits slow down.
A cyan coat that sheds the cold haze.
Boots with grips for walking on a world turned on its side.
A cyan-feathered hippogriff of the haze decks. It flies.
A spinning top on a thread.
A band of dark ring dust set in steel.
The Gale Exchange outfitters
Mara Tidecombe, outfitter
A deep-blue trident; its thrust hits like the fastest winds in the system.
A horn that blasts a wall of wind; foes are thrown back.
Deep-blue plate made to stand in a gale.
Great Dark Spot helm
A dark helm with a swirling oval crest.
A great sky-seahorse of Saphirel's wind-currents. It flies.
Triton geyser charm
A bead of Triton's frost.
Ilvessa, the Singing City
The Great Circle of Gifts: the outfitters' arc
Seren Valeth, outfitter
A blade that rings a clear note when drawn; it strikes as quick as a song.
A staff of singing crystal; its light draws vigour back to you.
Thread-woven war robe
A robe of grove thread, woven tight enough to turn a blade.
A thin silver circlet that hums softly.
A lilac unicorn whose horn hums as it runs.
A note held forever in glass.
Many voices are stronger than one.
The Driftwood Bazaar outfitters
Pippa Swiftbourne, outfitter
The Boatwrights' Sheds
A light sea-cutlass with a shell guard, quick in a scrap.
A sling of woven palm; its stones knock foes off their feet.
A green leather jerkin, light enough to climb in.
A crown of woven leaves and one bright feather.
A great cliff eagle of Aerieholm, big enough to carry a rider. It flies.
A locket with a pinch of fairy dust.
A whistle cut from a reed.
The Fish Quay chandlery
Nerys Coldwater, chandler
The Rope Works forge
A sailor's axe for boarding and cutting rope; its blows send foes staggering.
Saltcrown sea pistol
A brass-bound pistol that keeps its powder dry.
Navy blue with brass buttons, the cloth doubled at the shoulders.
A stiff captain's hat, lined with a steel cap.
A sea-green water horse of the Saltcrown stables, friendly and sure-footed.
A tiny compass that always settles.
Tied by Saltcrown's sail-makers.
The Great Clockwork Works shop
Holly Brightbell, shopkeeper
The Great Clockwork Works
the master clockmaker
A long blade bright as an icicle; foes it strikes slow with cold.
The elves' pride: a tube that lobs hard-packed snowballs, chilling whoever they hit.
Elf-stitched winter coat
A red coat trimmed white, stitched by the elves with quilted padding.
Warm, thick and padded.
A reindeer of the sky-teams, trained by the elves. It flies.
A small silver bell.
A live ember from Starhearth's fires, kept in a glass bead.
The Spoils Market armoury
The Great Forge of Varr
the Forgemaster of Varr
A siege-sword of the Bastion: every blow throws a foe back.
The Bastion's own rifle, quick-firing and hard-wearing.
Dark, heavy plate made for the field.
A closed helm with a crest of black horsehair.
A great elephant in armour, the pride of the Bastion's stables.
Given to those who came back.
Fight under the Bastion's banner.
The Great Corn Exchange outfitters
Bramble Hatchett, outfitter
The Coppice Woods smithy
A hedge-layer's billhook on a long haft, quick to swing.
Harrowmead yew bow
A long yew bow from the coppice woods; its arrows hit hard.
Shepherd's padded smock
A thick woollen smock, padded with fleece.
A wide straw hat over a leather cap.
Harrowmead plough ox
A strong red ox from the home farms; slow, steady and kind.
A bead of wax and honey.
Harrowmead clover charm
The Garnet Market outfitters
Brunna Coalheart, outfitter
Hearthdeep garnet axe
An axe set with deep garnets that glow like coals; foes it strikes burn.
A smith's hammer of silver-steel; it throws foes back.
Dark mail studded with red stones.
A helm with a small lantern on its crest.
A three-headed hound of the deep halls, fierce to strangers and loyal to its rider.
A jar of glowing caps.
Six seeds in amber.
The Cloud Bazaar outfitters
Mei Lanfeng, outfitter
The Rainmakers' Works
A staff crowned with a sunpearl; its light draws vigour back to you.
A fan that throws a cold rain; foes caught in it slow down.
A white robe of cloud-wool, softer than silk and tougher than leather.
A golden crown set with a small sunpearl.
A many-tailed white-gold fox that runs on the clouds. It flies.
Morning mist, bottled.
A golden drop that makes you light.
The Sunken Exchange outfitters
Ondine Merrow, outfitter
The Vent Mines forge
A trident of vent-forged steel; each thrust draws back a little vigour.
A diver's spear-gun; its barbs chill and slow.
Overlapping plates edged with pearl.
A round brass diving helm.
A bright, quick dolphin that carries a rider through the deep. It swims through the air as through water.
A ribbon of kelp that softens a blow.
A small lamp like the deep fish carry.
The Moonlight Fair outfitters
Thistle Morrowdew, outfitter
The Moonstone Delvings forge
A staff that throws thorns; whatever they catch is tangled and slowed.
A slender blade with a moonstone pommel; quick as a moth.
A cloak of gossamer silk, nearly weightless and surprisingly tough.
A vest of leaf-shaped scales, green and gold.
A great russet fox of the moonlit woods, quick and clever.
Dew gathered at dusk.
The Exchange of Rare Light outfitters
Ister Vane, outfitter
The Shard Quarries forge
A shard of held light; its beam draws vigour back to you.
A dark blade with a pale edge; where it cuts, things slow, as if time thickened.
A robe of deep violet scattered with tiny points of light.
A tall dark hat scattered with tiny stars.
A dark violet horse with a mane like a night sky.
Glowmoss in a locket; it brightens when you strike.
A moment held still.
The Market of Opposites outfitters
Lys and Syl Ambre, outfitters
The Glass Furnaces
Two daggers so alike nobody can tell which struck first.
A sword with an edge of clear quartz; it draws vigour back to you.
Plate polished to a mirror; foes see themselves coming.
Silvered gauntlets that turn a glancing blow.
A lion with a coat like polished silver.
A small mirror on a cord.
Two hearts that beat as one.
The Marigold Market outfitters
Abuela Rosalba, outfitter
A scythe hafted in pale willow; each sweep draws vigour back to you.
Lantern of the long road
A lantern on a staff; its flame leaps out and sets foes alight.
A bright poncho woven with marigold thread, padded within.
A wide hat embroidered with flowers and candles.
A great golden cat with dark rosettes, guardian of the long road.
A candle that never burns down.
Marigolds to guide the way.
The Frost Fair outfitters
Sigrun Ottarsdottir, outfitter
The Blue Ice Quarry forge
An axe with a head of blue-ice steel; foes it strikes slow with cold.
Isvarden hunting spear
A long spear of the ice-hunters; it knocks a foe back.
Mammoth-wool war coat
A heavy coat of mammoth wool over leather.
A helm with two short curved horns of blue ice-steel.
A woolly mammoth of the frost fairs, broad enough for a howdah.
Lichen that grows in the hardest cold.
A green glow like the aurora goes with you.
The Windglass Bazaar outfitters
A lance of singing crystal that hums before it strikes; its blast throws foes back.
A launcher of sticky spore-pods; whatever they hit is slowed.
Plates of hardened glassbark resin, clear as amber.
A rounded helm lined with breath-moss.
A teal-winged manticore of Ondrevar's cliffs, tamed by the golem-smiths. It flies.
A sprig of breath-moss.
A crystal that sings when you strike.
The Cinder Market outfitters
Ottra Vell, outfitter
The Great Foundry of Kilnhaven
the master founder
A longsword quenched in the lava runs; its edge stays hot and sets foes alight.
A foundry's flame-projector made a weapon; whatever it touches burns.
Blackened plate edged with obsidian.
Founders' gauntlets that will hold red-hot iron, and a blade.
A great black hound of the foundries, warm as an oven.
An ember that never goes out.
The Nebula Exchange outfitters
Orrin Vael, outfitter
The Meteoric Forge
A blade of meteoric iron that burns with starlight.
A rail-gun built at the Meteoric Forge; its shot throws foes back.
Dark plate hammered from fallen stars.
A cloak of deep blue swirled with violet.
A winged horse dark as the sky between stars. It flies.
A sliver of comet ice.
A shard of a star.
The Swap Market outfitters
Dusty Okoro, outfitter
The Scrap Mine forge
Made from salvage, and made well; its blast knocks foes back.
A blade cut from an old leaf-spring; quick and hard to break.
A leather jacket sewn with plates of salvaged steel.
A thick bandana over a padded cap, against the grit.
A big, tough boar that can find water anywhere.
Clean-water flask charm
A flask that is always a little full.
The Grand Spice Souk outfitters
Zahir al-Qamar, outfitter
The Glass Kilns forge
A curved blade with a turquoise pommel, quick in the hand.
A short recurved bow made for shooting from the saddle.
A flowing robe with a padded lining against heat and blades.
A long headwrap fixed with a turquoise pin.
Sahmira racing camel
A swift pale camel of the Sahmira races.
Saffron thread charm
Worth more than gold, they say.
A crystal of desert salt.
The Repair-and-Share Market outfitters
Ade Sunmola, outfitter
A returning disc made in the Maker Halls.
Renewable arc caster
Runs on renewed cells; its arc draws vigour back to you.
Bioplastic shell suit
Light green-white panels over a soft suit.
A clear visor with a heads-up display.
A steel-grey winged steed with green-lit wings, bred and fitted out in the Maker Halls. It flies.
A tiny battery on a chain.
A sprig grown in the towers.
The Hall of Anvils' outfitters' gallery
Ilvara Duskweave, outfitter
The Hall of Anvils
A dark-elf blade of deepsilver; each cut draws vigour back to you.
A small crossbow strung with spider silk; its bolts slow whatever they strike.
Fine mail of pale deepsilver, light and very hard.
A tiny blue bottle.
